problem: TriOS kept the narrow companion-panel chat layout at desktop and full-screen widths, leaving no persistent task history and producing an excessively wide conversation surface.
solution: An adaptive workspace now switches at 760 points to a ChatGPT-like layout with a collapsible searchable task-history sidebar and a centered 900-point conversation column. The compact layout and the existing ChatPanelView remain the single chat implementation.
lesson: A desktop chat should adapt around one canonical conversation view. History navigation belongs in a width-aware workspace shell, while message rendering, streaming, and the composer remain shared across compact and full-screen modes.
